name: Avatar network halo
looks: A loose cloud of small round avatar or icon bubbles scatters across the frame at varying depths and sizes around a single glowing hub mark at the centre, with no drawn lines connecting them. Beneath it a dollar or count value rolls up live.
build: The hub is a bright circular mark with a soft bloom, pinned centre-frame. Each avatar bubble sits at a seeded position within a radial falloff from the centre, landing on a loose overlapping stagger. The value beneath uses data-infographic's digit roll-up, finishing just after the bubbles settle.
sound: A soft shimmer as the bubbles populate, and a rising tone under the counting value.
prompt: Prove a network effect: scatter a loose cloud of small avatar or icon bubbles around a single glowing hub mark, no lines needed, just proximity and a shared glow, with a count or dollar value rolling up live beneath it.
source: a dub.co launch promo shared by @steventey (x.com/steventey/status/2103625902211088880), studied 2026-10-09
